I found Hub/ServiceRouting.cs. I searched for it and opened it, which switched the page to the Local Map view. This link should show you the same view:

http://127.0.0.1:8792/samples/estate/?%2BF8Mty7mwADEnHY3eMzsopgARYHSmEgJ4rfDi5r4Nlus4ddYgCpVHJQarYHRceAAK0z2dzIFQUAA2iAywAdED4dY12A1gASZFEAHogQ4Xg0EStwRt3ugdA2awAqGsAXRAE-gjLOpLI6HyuRA2ygIBb7c73cRffWqkHvng-DLoEhkA3rY7bJ3vbI-YPQ9XZ3Xo9TE4qQA

The file sits inside the Hub group. It's open on its own card, which lists four symbols: ServiceRouting, EndpointPrefix, EndpointNameFor and Internals. Next to it you'll see a link to PaymentHub.cs.

The link points to 127.0.0.1, which is my own machine. It will only work if you have the same server running on your computer.
